summary: Nora can send any kind of file from her computer (audio, video, archives, data), not only pictures, PDFs and text; a web page is still refused.
details: An MP3 or MP4 she made is now attached, linked or kept instead of being refused.
Many files go out as one zip.
A file nothing recognises leaves as a download (application/octet-stream).
limitations: The 25 MB export cap is unchanged, and each platform's own attachment limit still applies.
Three exports per turn, as before.
